licensing.title: Licensing & credit
licensing.description: Read the work’s own licence, preserve artist credit and check permission before remixing.
paragraphs: Each work lists its artist, source and licence. A free download is not a general permission to change or sell every work. The website is non-commercial; individual works retain their own commercial-use terms.

CC0 placeholders are original AI-assisted vector studies for testing, not real artist contributions. Fonts and brand assets have separate terms. The software licence does not replace an artwork licence.

The Studio excludes NoDerivatives works, including CC BY-NC-ND, from bases and element libraries. Such works may be offered as downloads under their stated licence. Ask the artist directly about permissions beyond that licence.

Keep required artist credits, sources and licence notices. ShareAlike sources require the applicable licence on shared adaptations. Studio exports compose source credits automatically and reject incompatible source combinations. User additions are not automatically dedicated to CC0.

Read the linked licence itself before reuse. If a credit or permission is wrong, contact the team with the work URL. Removal from this archive cannot recall copies that other people already downloaded.

contributor-guidelines.title: Contributor guidelines
contributor-guidelines.description: Prepare a rights-cleared contribution with credit, source, language and an honest AI-use declaration. Image descriptions are optional and welcome.
paragraphs: Share only work you made or have explicit permission to publish. Supply the source and licence, an approved artist credit, an optional image description, language, categories and tags. Pseudonymous artist names are welcome.

Public contact email and UPI ID are optional. Each field needs separate explicit consent before publication. An account email, when accounts become available, must never automatically become public artist contact.

The upload form recommends sharing and remixing while keeping remixes open (CC BY-SA 4.0). You can choose credit-only remixing, unrestricted use, or unchanged sharing; a non-commercial checkbox is available except for CC0. The legal-details disclosure links the exact licence. Only grant rights you hold. ND works never enter the Studio.

Declare AI use honestly: none, minimal-assisted or generated, with an explanation where helpful. A disclosure is not proof of copyright permission. Current in-house placeholder studies are marked generated and are not presented as curated human submissions.
Check print dimensions, credit strips and one sample print. A 300 DPI label alone does not establish adequate image detail. Avoid unnecessary identifying information in the artwork or proposal.

Contributions can be submitted without an account and are uploaded privately for metadata removal and human review. Optional accounts provide a contribution dashboard. Nothing is published automatically. NoDerivatives work may be downloaded under its licence but is never offered for Studio remix.
